text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki brilliantly claimed victory
in 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
She put on a truly 
breathtaking show for the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she was unusually fired 
up. It seems Fuji Kiseki has grasped 
something vital as an entertainer...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up, at long last,
is the Arima Kinen. 
Her grand show now heads toward its 
climax――
